sentences.literal: Henei commandery.
sentences.idiomatic: The commandery of Henei.

sentences.literal: The Han dynastically established it.
sentences.idiomatic: It had been founded under the Han.

sentences.literal: It governed nine counties, with fifty-two thousand registered households.
sentences.idiomatic: Nine counties lay under its administration; the household registers counted fifty-two thousand.

sentences.literal: Yewang.
sentences.idiomatic: Yewang county.

sentences.literal: Mount Taihang lies to the northwest.
sentences.idiomatic: To the northwest rise the slopes of Mount Taihang.

sentences.literal: Zhou.
sentences.idiomatic: The county of Zhou.

sentences.literal: In antiquity it was a settlement of Jin.
sentences.idiomatic: It was once a town belonging to Jin.

sentences.literal: Huai and Pinggao.
sentences.idiomatic: Huai county and Pinggao county.

sentences.literal: The Marquis of Xing moved his seat from Xiangguo to this place.
sentences.idiomatic: Here the lord of Xing relocated after leaving the old capital at Xiangguo.

sentences.literal: Heyang, Qinshui, and Zhi.
sentences.idiomatic: The registry lists Heyang, Qinshui, and Zhi.

sentences.literal: In antiquity it was the settlement of Zhouyuan.
sentences.idiomatic: It preserves the memory of Zhouyuan, an ancient town.

sentences.literal: Shanyang and Wen.
sentences.idiomatic: Shanyang county and Wen county.

sentences.literal: It was a state of old; Su Fensheng received it as his fief.
sentences.idiomatic: Long ago it was a little kingdom, granted to Su Fensheng.

sentences.literal: Guangping commandery.
sentences.idiomatic: Guangping commandery.

sentences.literal: The Wei dynastically established it.
sentences.idiomatic: Wei had carved this district out of the map.

sentences.chinese: 統縣十五，戶三萬五千二百。〉
sentences.literal: It governed fifteen counties, with thirty-five thousand two hundred registered households.
sentences.idiomatic: Fifteen counties answered to its yamen, and the census recorded thirty-five thousand two hundred households.

sentences.literal: Guangping and Handan.
sentences.idiomatic: Guangping county and Handan county.

sentences.literal: The Qin dynastically established it as a commandery.
sentences.idiomatic: The Qin first organized this territory as a commandery.

sentences.chinese: 易陽 武安 涉 襄國
sentences.literal: Yiyang, Wu'an, She, and Xiangguo.
sentences.idiomatic: The roll names Yiyang, Wu'an, She, and Xiangguo.

sentences.literal: In antiquity it was the capital of the Marquis of Xing's state.
sentences.idiomatic: Once it had served as the capital when the house of Xing held a marquisate.

sentences.chinese: 南和 任 曲梁 列人 肥鄉 臨水 廣年
sentences.literal: Nanhe, Ren, Quliang, Lieren, Feixiang, Linshui, and Guangnian.
sentences.idiomatic: Seven counties are listed: Nanhe, Ren, Quliang, Lieren, Feixiang, Linshui, and Guangnian.

sentences.literal: The chancellor of a marquisate.
sentences.idiomatic: Its magistrate bore the title of a marquis's chancellor.

sentences.literal: Chizhang and Ping'en.
sentences.idiomatic: Chizhang county and Ping'en county.

sentences.literal: Yangping commandery.
sentences.idiomatic: Yangping commandery.

sentences.literal: The Wei dynastically established it.
sentences.idiomatic: Wei first drew this circuit on the atlas.

sentences.literal: It governed seven counties, with fifty-one thousand registered households.
sentences.idiomatic: Seven counties fell within its bounds; the rosters held fifty-one thousand households.

sentences.literal: Yuancheng.
sentences.idiomatic: Yuancheng county.

sentences.literal: It was the natal settlement of Empress Yuan of Han.
sentences.idiomatic: Empress Yuan of Han had been born in this place.

sentences.chinese: 館陶 清泉[11]發干 東武陽 陽平 樂平
sentences.literal: Guantao, Qingquan, Fagan, Dongwuyang, Yangping, and Leping.
sentences.idiomatic: Its townships include Guantao, Qingquan, Fagan, Dongwuyang, Yangping, and Leping.

sentences.literal: Wei commandery.
sentences.idiomatic: Wei commandery.

sentences.literal: The Han dynastically established it.
sentences.idiomatic: The Han had first chartered it.

sentences.literal: It governed eight counties, with forty thousand seven hundred registered households.
sentences.idiomatic: Eight counties stood under its jurisdiction; forty thousand seven hundred households were inscribed.

sentences.literal: Ye.
sentences.idiomatic: Ye, the great city.

sentences.literal: Wei Wu (Cao Cao) received his investiture and made his home here.
sentences.idiomatic: Here Cao Cao, posthumously honoured as Wei Wu, took his enfeoffment and built his court.

sentences.chinese: 長樂 魏 斥丘 安陽 蕩陰 內黃
sentences.literal: Changle, Wei, Chiqiu, Anyang, Dangyin, and Neihuang.
sentences.idiomatic: Changle, Wei, Chiqiu, Anyang, Dangyin, and Neihuang complete the list.

sentences.literal: Huang Pool lies to the west.
sentences.idiomatic: Westward one finds the banks of Huang Pool.

sentences.literal: Liyang.
sentences.idiomatic: Liyang county.

sentences.literal: In antiquity it was the state of the Marquis of Li.
sentences.idiomatic: In former days it had been the fief of the lords of Li.

sentences.literal: Dunqiu commandery.
sentences.idiomatic: Dunqiu commandery.

sentences.literal: It was established in the second year of the Taishi era.
sentences.idiomatic: The court created it in Taishi 2.

sentences.literal: It governed four counties, with six thousand three hundred registered households.
sentences.idiomatic: Four counties answered to it; the tallies showed six thousand three hundred households.

sentences.chinese: 頓丘 繁陽 陰安 衛
sentences.literal: Dunqiu, Fanyang, Yin'an, and Wei.
sentences.idiomatic: Dunqiu, Fanyang, Yin'an, and Wei are enumerated.

sentences.chinese: 永嘉之後，司州淪沒劉聰。
sentences.literal: After the Yongjia debacle, Sizhou sank beneath Liu Cong's sway.
sentences.idiomatic: When Yongjia shattered the north, Sizhou passed into Liu Cong's hands.

sentences.chinese: 聰以洛陽爲荊州，及石勒，復以爲司州。
sentences.literal: Cong made Luoyang into Jingzhou; under Shi Le it became Sizhou again.
sentences.idiomatic: Liu Cong redesignated Luoyang as Jingzhou, but once Shi Le held the city the old name Sizhou returned.

sentences.chinese: 石季龍又分司州之河南、河東、弘農、滎陽，兗州之陳留、東燕爲洛州。
sentences.literal: Shi Jilong further carved Henan, Hedong, Hongnong, and Xingyang out of Sizhou, and Chenliu and Dongyan out of Yanzhou, to constitute Luozhou.
sentences.idiomatic: Shi Hu, styled Jilong, then prised Henan, Hedong, Hongnong, and Xingyang from Sizhou, joined them to Chenliu and Dongyan taken from Yanzhou, and called the new circuit Luozhou.

sentences.chinese: 元帝渡江，亦僑置司州於徐，非本所也。
sentences.literal: When Yuan Di crossed the Yangzi, Sizhou was also set up in exile at Xu, not its native ground.
sentences.idiomatic: After Sima Rui forded the great river as Prince of Langya and later Yuan Emperor of Jin, a shadow Sizhou was planted at Xu, far from its homeland.

sentences.chinese: 後以弘農人流寓尋陽者僑立爲弘農郡。
sentences.literal: Later, Hongnang people who had drifted to Xunyang had a Hongnang commandery erected for them in exile.
sentences.idiomatic: Refugees from Hongnang who washed up at Xunyang received a paper commandery that bore their old name.

sentences.chinese: 又以河東人南寓者，於漢武陵郡孱陵縣界上明地僑立河東郡，統安邑、聞喜、永安、臨汾、弘農、譙、松滋、大戚八縣。
sentences.literal: Likewise, for Hedong people who had fled south, authorities set up Hedong commandery in exile at Shangming on the border of Chanling county within Han-era Wuling commandery, governing Anyi, Wenxi, Yong'an, Linfen, Hongnong, Qiao, Songzi, and Daqi, eight counties in all.
sentences.idiomatic: Hedong refugees were granted a paper commandery at Shangming, straddling the line of Chanling in the old Han circuit of Wuling, and the statute listed Anyi, Wenxi, Yong'an, Linfen, Hongnong, Qiao, Songzi, and Daqi—the full count of eight counties.

sentences.literal: All dwelled there as guest registrants.
sentences.idiomatic: Every clan was entered on the books as temporary residents.

sentences.chinese: 永和五年，桓溫入洛，復置河南郡，屬司州。
sentences.literal: In the fifth year of Yonghe, Huan Wen entered Luoyang; Henan commandery was restored and placed under Sizhou.
sentences.idiomatic: When Huan Wen marched into Luoyang in Yonghe 5, Henan commandery rose again on the statute book inside Sizhou.

sentences.chinese: 案禹貢濟河之地，舜置十二牧，則其一也。
sentences.literal: According to the Yugong, in the lands between the Ji River and the Yellow River, Shun established twelve shepherds, and this region was one of them.
sentences.idiomatic: The "Tribute of Yu" describes the country between the Ji and the great river; there Shun once posted twelve regional shepherds, and this tract was among them.

sentences.literal: The Rites of Zhou states, "The country east of the river is called Yanzhou."
sentences.idiomatic: "East of the Yellow River," says the "Rites of Zhou," "men name that territory Yanzhou."

sentences.chinese: 」《春秋元命包》云：「五星流爲兗州。
sentences.literal: The Spring and Autumn Yuanchunbao says, "The five stars flow to become Yanzhou."
sentences.idiomatic: The esoteric "Yuanchunbao" adds that the five wandering stars pour their light into Yanzhou.

sentences.literal: Yan means upright correctness; it also means good faith.
sentences.idiomatic: The gloss plays on the graph: "Yan" carries the sense of being straight, and of being trustworthy.

sentences.literal: It also says, "In all likelihood it draws its name from the Yan River."
sentences.idiomatic: The same text supposes people took the name from a Yan River threading the plain.

sentences.chinese: 」漢武帝置十三州，以舊名爲兗州，自此不改。
sentences.literal: Emperor Wu of Han established thirteen provinces; adopting the old designation, he called this one Yanzhou, and thereafter it was not altered.
sentences.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Han divided the realm into thirteen provinces, he kept the ancient label Yanzhou for this belt, and later ages let it stand.

sentences.chinese: 州統郡國八，縣五十六，戶八萬三千三百。
sentences.literal: The province governed eight commanderies and principalities, fifty-six counties, and eighty-three thousand three hundred registered households.
sentences.idiomatic: Yanzhou oversaw eight jurisdictions and fifty-six counties; the census read eighty-three thousand three hundred households.

sentences.literal: Chenliu principality.
sentences.idiomatic: The principality of Chenliu.

sentences.literal: The Han dynastically established it.
sentences.idiomatic: The Han had first created it.

sentences.literal: It governed ten counties, with thirty thousand households.
sentences.idiomatic: Ten counties and thirty thousand households fell under its seal.

sentences.literal: Wei Emperor Wu enfeoffed it.
sentences.idiomatic: The territory had been invested as a principality under Wei Emperor Wu—Cao Cao.

sentences.literal: End of bracketed gloss.
sentences.idiomatic: The marginal note closes.

sentences.literal: Xiaohuang and Junyi.
sentences.idiomatic: Xiaohuang county and Junyi county.

sentences.literal: There is the Hong Ditch, where Han Gaozu and Xiang Yu intended to divide their positions.
sentences.idiomatic: The Hong Ditch still cuts the fields—where Liu Bang and Xiang Yu once meant to draw the boundary between their worlds.

sentences.literal: Fengqiu and Suanzao.
sentences.idiomatic: Fengqiu county and Suanzao county.

sentences.literal: The ground of Wuchao lies to the southeast.
sentences.idiomatic: To the southeast lies the soil made famous at Wuchao.

sentences.literal: Jiyang and Changyuan.
sentences.idiomatic: Jiyang county and Changyuan county.

sentences.literal: In antiquity it was Kuang city, where Confucius was besieged.
sentences.idiomatic: This was old Kuang, where Confucius found himself surrounded between starvation and rain.

sentences.literal: Yongqiu.
sentences.idiomatic: Yongqiu county.

sentences.literal: In antiquity it was the state of Qi.
sentences.idiomatic: The ruined polity of Qi (the house of Zhu) once held these walls.

sentences.chinese: 尉氏 襄邑 外黃
sentences.literal: Weishi, Xiangyi, and Waihuang.
sentences.idiomatic: Weishi, Xiangyi, and Waihuang round out the circuit.

sentences.literal: Puyang principality.
sentences.idiomatic: The Puyang principality.

sentences.literal: Formerly it belonged to Dong commandery; at the beginning of Jin, Jin split off Dong commandery and established it.
sentences.idiomatic: Once a corner of Dong commandery, the new Jin court split it away as a separate domain.

sentences.literal: It governed four counties, with twenty-one thousand households.
sentences.idiomatic: Four counties and twenty-one thousand households answered to its prince.

sentences.literal: Puyang.
sentences.idiomatic: Puyang county.

sentences.literal: In antiquity it was the state of Kunwu.
sentences.idiomatic: Antiquity remembers a Kunwu kingdom rooted here.

sentences.chinese: 師延爲紂作靡靡之樂，既而投此水。
sentences.literal: Shi Yan composed wanton music for King Zhou of Shang, then threw himself into this water.
sentences.idiomatic: The court musician Shi Yan once fashioned decadent tunes for Di Xin, the last Shang king, and afterward drowned himself in this same stream.

sentences.literal: Chancellor of a ducal principality.
sentences.idiomatic: Its chief official was titled chancellor of a duchy-level principality.

sentences.literal: Linqiu.
sentences.idiomatic: Linqiu county.

sentences.literal: Chancellor of a ducal principality.
sentences.idiomatic: A ducal chancellor administered the district.

sentences.literal: There is Yangjiao city.
sentences.idiomatic: Ruins called Yangjiao city crown a nearby height.

sentences.literal: Baima.
sentences.idiomatic: Baima county.

sentences.literal: There is the Huzi embankment.
sentences.idiomatic: The Huzi dike, raised against the angry river, still snakes through the flats.

sentences.literal: Juancheng.
sentences.idiomatic: Juancheng county.

sentences.literal: Chancellor of a ducal principality.
sentences.idiomatic: Another county entrusted to a ducal chancellor.

sentences.literal: Jiyin commandery.
sentences.idiomatic: Jiyin commandery.

sentences.literal: The Han dynastically established it.
sentences.idiomatic: Han scribes first established the office.

sentences.literal: It governed nine counties, with seven thousand six hundred registered households.
sentences.idiomatic: Nine counties remained; only seven thousand six hundred households still appeared on the registers.

sentences.literal: Dingtao.
sentences.idiomatic: Dingtao county.

sentences.literal: Han Gaozu enfeoffed Peng Yue as King of Liang and set his capital here.
sentences.idiomatic: Liu Bang crowned Peng Yue king of Liang and seated his throne in this town.

sentences.literal: Chengshi.
sentences.idiomatic: Chengshi county.

sentences.literal: In antiquity it was a marquisate.
sentences.idiomatic: The name preserves an old marquisate.

sentences.chinese: 句陽 離狐 宛句[16]己氏 成武
sentences.literal: Gousu, Lihu, Yuanqu, Jishi, and Chengwu.
sentences.idiomatic: Gousu, Lihu, Yuanqu, Jishi, and Chengwu are named in order.

sentences.literal: There is Chuqiu pavilion.
sentences.idiomatic: A pavilion still marks Chuqiu.

sentences.literal: Shanfu.
sentences.idiomatic: Shanfu county.

sentences.literal: In antiquity it was a marquisate.
sentences.idiomatic: Once again the ledger remembers a former marquisate.

sentences.literal: Chengyang.
sentences.idiomatic: Chengyang county.

sentences.literal: It is where Shun fished; Yao's tomb lies to the west.
sentences.idiomatic: Shun is said to have angled beside this marsh, while westward the mound claims to hold Emperor Yao.

sentences.literal: Gaoping principality.
sentences.idiomatic: The Gaoping principality.

sentences.literal: Formerly it belonged to Liang principality; at the beginning of Jin, Jin split it off from Shanyang and established it.
sentences.idiomatic: It had been a dependency of Liang; the early Jin court peeled it away from Shanyang to form its own princely seat.
